metadata.question: Did the area around Walvis Bay, Nambia during February, 2021 show higher NDVI than the 2010 to 2020 average for the same month?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about comparing NDVI values in Walvis Bay, Namibia for February 2021 vs the 2010-2020 average for February. This requires: 1. Location: Walvis Bay, Namibia - I'll create a point geometry 2. Time periods: - Target: February 2021 - Baseline: February 2010-2020 (average of all February months) 3. Data: I'll use MODIS NDVI (MOD13Q1.061) which has good temporal coverage 4. Processing: Calculate NDVI for both periods and compare 5. Validation: Check for empty collections and valid pixels I need to: - Get MODIS NDVI collection - Filter for February 2021 - Filter for February 2010-2020 - Calculate mean NDVI for baseline period - Compare 2021 vs baseline average - Handle cases where collections are empty or no valid pixels For MODIS NDVI (MOD13Q1.061), the NDVI band is 'NDVI' and it's scaled by 0.0001. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const walvisBay = ee.Geometry.Point([14.5053, -22.9576]); // Walvis Bay, Namibia const region = walvisBay.buffer(5000); // 5km buffer around the point // 2. Data Acquisition const modisCol = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD13Q1'); // February 2021 data const feb2021 = modisCol .filterBounds(region) .filterDate('2021-02-01', '2021-03-01') .select('NDVI'); // February 2010-2020 baseline data const baselineCol = modisCol .filterBounds(region) .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2, 2, 'month')) // February only .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2010, 2020, 'year')) .select('NDVI'); // Check collection sizes const feb2021Size = feb2021.size().getInfo(); const baselineSize = baselineCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2021 February Images: ${feb2021Size}`); console.log(`2010-2020 February Images: ${baselineSize}`); if (feb2021Size === 0 || baselineSize === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Calculate mean NDVI for baseline const baselineMean = baselineCol.mean().multiply(0.0001); // Scale factor for MODIS NDVI const feb2021Mean = feb2021.mean().multiply(0.0001); // 4. Calculate pixel counts to check for valid data const baselineCount = baselineMean .reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); const feb2021Count = feb2021Mean .reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); console.log(`Baseline valid pixels: ${baselineCount}`); console.log(`2021 valid pixels: ${feb2021Count}`); if (baselineCount === 0 || feb2021Count === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // 5. Extract NDVI values const baselineNDVI = baselineMean .reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); const feb2021NDVI = feb2021Mean .reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); console.log(`Baseline NDVI (2010-2020 Feb avg): ${baselineNDVI?.toFixed(4)}`); console.log(`2021 February NDVI: ${feb2021NDVI?.toFixed(4)}`); // 6. Validation & Final Answer if (baselineNDVI === null || feb2021NDVI === null || isNaN(baselineNDVI) || isNaN(feb2021NDVI)) { console.log("C3"); } else if (feb2021NDVI > baselineNDVI) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
